summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for cloud cybersecurity control-plane software. The obvious reference anchors are Palo Alto Networks, because it completed the CyberArk acquisition and now owns a major identity/security control-plane asset, and Akamai, because API security is increasingly part of its security platform. The underfollowed discovery lane is stronger in identity governance and OT/exposure management: SailPoint and Tenable are both public, sub-$10B market-cap candidates with plausible direct exposure to enterprise identity governance, non-human/AI-agent identity, public-sector compliance, OT visibility, and vulnerability/exposure workflows. This is a research universe only, not a trading recommendation. Expanded the universe around cloud cybersecurity control-plane software with one reference leader and three underfollowed/smaller discovery candidates. The strongest direct chokepoint exposures found in this pass are identity security for human/machine/AI identities, exposure management spanning IT/cloud/OT/AI, AI-era data governance/compliance automation, and high-assurance authentication for regulated digital transactions. No buy/sell view is implied; this is a research universe expansion only. Expanded one supply-chain node using a two-lane Serenity funnel.
